title: OpenAI runner options
description: The run/start options the OpenAI runner takes, each optional. They fill the runner contract's runnerOptions extension point. The service (its endpoint, model and credential) comes from the run's runtime, never from these options.

maxTurns.description: The most requests a run may send to the service. Absent: the runner's default, 50.

maxTotalTokens.description: The most input plus output tokens a run may use, summed over its responses as the service reports them. Checked after each response, so a run can pass it by one response. Absent: the runner's default, 1,000,000.
